notes.title: Return of the Pixel Style and the Power of Choice
notes.notes: [p]Earlier, we experimented with the look of the game and swapped the unique pixel “trash” style for a card-game imitation. Some players weren’t too thrilled about that change. Now both styles are available, and everyone can choose the one they like best.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195421/52a64b41a1aec842431816b60069be319faaa4ee.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195421/92b82774e3cdb2fb6aefb3e547b8d143d552e335.png"][/img][/p]
